Module CW2013
Package SnakeGame.Controllers

Class ItemsController

java.lang.Object
SnakeGame.RunnableSceneController
SnakeGame.Controllers.ItemsController
public class ItemsController extends RunnableSceneController
Controller class for managing game items such as food, obstacles, and power-ups. Extends RunnableSceneController for handling scene transitions. Handles item interactions with the snake and updates the UI accordingly.
Author:
Guilherme Julio

    • eaten

      public void eaten(SnakeModel mySnake)
      Handles the event when the snake eats the food item. Increases the snake's length and updates the score.
      Parameters:
      mySnake - The snake model.

    • slowMoHit

      public void slowMoHit(SnakeModel mySnake)
      Handles the event when the snake collides with the slow motion power-up. Slows down the game for a duration.
      Parameters:
      mySnake - The snake model.

    • doublePointsHit

      public void doublePointsHit(SnakeModel mySnake)
      Handles the event when the snake collides with the double points power-up. Doubles the points earned for a duration.
      Parameters:
      mySnake - The snake model.

    • fastSpeedHit

      public void fastSpeedHit(SnakeModel mySnake)
      Handles the event when the snake collides with the fast speed power-up. Increases the game speed for a duration.
      Parameters:
      mySnake - The snake model.

    • obstacleHit

      public void obstacleHit(SnakeModel mySnake)
      Handles the event when the snake collides with the obstacle. Reduces the snake's length upon collision.
      Parameters:
      mySnake - The snake model.
